context:
Implement the narrower exact-path affordance rather than batch submission.
Reuse `ResultExporter.list_results()`, because it already filters primary
schema-v2 result JSON files and excludes `.plans.json`, `.tuning.json`, and
hosted `.submission.json` sidecars. Keep `benchbox submit RESULT.json
--output DIR` unchanged, and keep hosted submission behind explicit
`--service`.
description:
W5 had to loop `benchbox submit` over 388 captured result paths one file at a
time. A guessed result filename failed clearly, but the flow still lacks an
obvious way for contributors to copy exact result paths from history or submit
a batch of successful local results.

anti_patterns.instead: default to local package output or explicit confirmation.

preserves.behavior: No hosted upload occurs unless `--service` is explicitly requested.
Single-file `benchbox submit RESULT.json --output DIR` continues to work.

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/cli/commands/test_results.py tests/unit/cli/commands/test_submit.py -q
verifications.description: CLI tests cover exact-path discovery or batch submission.
Submit help remains terminating and documents the affordance.
verifications.expected: help includes the new path or batch affordance

verifications.description: Results help remains terminating and documents path discovery.
verifications.expected: help includes the exact-path discovery flag

work_units.notes:
Inventory found `benchbox submit` already accepts one exact result path and
`--last`, while `benchbox results` lists recent result metadata without the
source file paths that submit can consume. Hosted submission history is a
separate sidecar flow (`benchbox results --submitted`) and should not be
conflated with local result discovery. The minimal unblocked affordance is
therefore exact path discovery in `benchbox results`, plus a submit help
tip pointing contributors to that command.
work_units.summary: Inventory existing result discovery, history, and submit command paths

work_units.notes:
Own the CLI affordance only: add a copyable exact result-path view to
`benchbox results` and update `benchbox submit --help` so users know how to
discover the paths. Do not add batch hosted upload in this TODO; hosted
submission stays explicit and one bundle at a time.
work_units.summary: Add a minimal exact-path or batch-submission affordance

work_units.notes:
Document the exact-path discovery path in contributor-facing CLI docs and
run the focused CLI tests plus terminating help commands.
work_units.summary: Document and test the contributor-facing path
